thread:
Tess R: quick proposal for the next webinar: 'Inference Showcase: Shipable Demos' 1 idea = three short demos (model pick, routing, fallback) + a 10-min hands-on checklist for attendees.
Ibrahim S: neat. suggest keep it 40m total so we can do 20m demos, 10m checklist walkthrough, 10m Q&A. attendees should leave with 1 repo and 1 playbook.
Rowan J: run-of-show draft:
```
00:00-03:00 host intro + promise
03:00-13:00 Demo 1: picking a model for latency vs accuracy
13:00-23:00 Demo 2: routing and canaries (live dashboard)
23:00-33:00 Demo 3: graceful fallback + pre-record backup
33:00-40:00 checklist walkthrough + CTA
40:00-50:00 Q&A if needed
```
Keiko H: important: pre-record 2-minute fallback clips and a 5-min combined demo in case infra flaps. also ask speakers for 30s promo clips.
Tess R: promo cadence: -21 announce, -14 tech deep-dive post, -7 speaker teasers, day-of reminder. gate the playbook behind registration; add a field "one production constraint" to seed the checklist exercise.
Ibrahim S: metrics to surface: p95 latency, cost/1k tokens, failure rate. keep dashboard to 3 panels max.
Rowan J: rehearsal plan: full dry-run 48h prior (45m), tech check 1h prior (20m). deploy-bot: create invites and reminders 48h and 1h before.
Tess R: action items: Keiko = pre-records + slides (due Fri), Rowan = infra + dashboard (due Fri), Ibrahim = landing copy + gating (due Thu). I'll coordinate speakers and host script.
Keiko H: noted. I'll also build a short host fallback script in case we switch to recordings.
Tess R: locking this format unless objections by EOD. thanks! :thumbsup:
